paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah mite'n ateikhiak uh, hiaite leng Solomon paunakte ahi uh.
heading: Solomon Paunak Dangte
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

paite: Thil iim Pathian thupina ahi; himahleh thu zonkhiak kumpite thupina ahi.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

paite: Van sandan, huan lei thukdan, huan kumpipate lungtang zonkhiak theih ahi kei hi.
english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

paite: Dangka a kipan tui-ek lamang in, huan siangsakmi a ding in tui-um belsuan ahong omkhe ding.
english: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

paite: Kumpipa ma a kipan gilou lamang in, huan alaltutphah diktatna a hihkip ahi ding hi.
english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

paite: Kumpipa ma ah malam sang ah om ke'n, huan mithupite omna mun ah dingh ke'n.
english: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

paite: Hiai lam ah hong paitou in, na kiang a ahon chih uh ahoihzaw; na mitte'n amuhsa uh, lal ma a koihniam a na om sang in.
english: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

paite: Sual ding in kinoh in kuankhe pah ke'n, atawp in bang hih ding ahia chih na thei kei kha ding.
english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

paite: Na inveng toh kal thu amau toh genkhawm un, huan midang thugukte pholhsuah ke'n!
english: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

paite: Huai za in nang a hon kou kha dia, na zahlakna akiheimang kei kha ding hi.
english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

paite: Kituaktak a thu khat gen dangka kuang sung a dangka-eng epul theite bang ahi.
english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

paite: Thumangmi bil ah taihilh mipil dangka-eng bilbah leh dangka-eng hoih chỉ khi bang ahi.
english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

paite: Pawltak huan vukvot bang in, huchi in sawltak ginom amah sawlte a ding in ahi; apute kha ahihhalh zel hi.
english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

paite: Vuah pai lou meipite leh huih bang in, huchi in kuapeuh dikloutak a athilpiakte a ki-uangsak ahi hi.
english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

paite: Doh theih mahmahna in vaihawmpa thuzoh ahi, huan lei nem in guh ahihtan ding hi.
english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

paite: Khuaizu na muta hia? Nang a dia hun lel ne in; huchi lou in zaw na vah ding a, na lo kha ding hi.
english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

paite: Na inveng inn ah hoh vang in; huchi lou in zaw ahon chimtak in ahon mudah kha ding hi.
english: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

paite: A-inveng siatna dia zuaugen khetbuk, namsau leh thal hiam bang ahi.
english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

paite: Buai hun a miginom lou muan zaw ha kisia leh khepek guh kilawi bang ahi.
english: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

paite: Milunggim kiang a lasa tuh khovot lai a puansilh suah bang leh zu leh tangal hel bang ahi.
english: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

paite: Na melma agil akialleh nek ding tanghou pia inla; huan adang atakleh, dawn ding tui pia in.
english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

paite: Alutung a mei-am sekkhawm hi ding lah na hi ngal a, huan TOUPA'N kipahman nang a hon pe ding hi.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.

paite: Mal huih in vuah ahon zusak pah a; huchibang in migensiatna lei in hehmel abawl hi.
english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

paite: Inn tung ning a ten, insung za a kisel hat numei toh tenkhawm sang in ahoihzaw hi.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

paite: Kha dangtak a dia tui votte bang in, gam gamla a pan tanchinhoih ahi.
english: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

paite: Migilou in midiktat alam pialsak tuh tuikhuk suknit leh tui nak hihsiat bang ahi.
english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

paite: Khuaizu tampi nek ahoih kei; huchi mah bang in mite ding in amau thupina zonkhiak thupina ahi kei.
english: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

paite: Amah a lungsim thuzohna bei khopi chimsa leh bang nei lou bang ahi.
english: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
